opennyai_summary.1_December_2025__facts:
The appellant has been convicted under sections 376(2)(n) & 376(2)(i) of the IPC and under section 6 read with section 5(l) of the POCSO Act, 2012 and has been sentenced to 10 years RI under section 376(2)(n) and 10 years RI under section 376(2)(i) of the IPC.
The trial court committed error in convicting the appellant.
The trial court committed error in not considering the fact that the complainant malafidely implicated the appellant.
The appellant has been convicted for committing aggravated penetrative sexual assault with a child of 13 years.
opennyai_summary.1_December_2025__ANALYSIS:
This 5th application has been preferred on the ground that appellant has suffered approximately 4 years in jail.
There is no apprehension that he will abscond in the case.
opennyai_summary.1_December_2025__decision:
First application of the appellant was dismissed vide order dated 27.06.2023 on merits.
Thereafter,
second application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 04.03.2024 and third application was dismissed 2 CRA-12326-2022 as withdrawn on 15.10.2024.
The fourth application was dismissed vide order dated 09.09.2025 with the following observation:
7. There is aggravated penetrative sexual assault by 27 years old M.B.A. graduate (Exhibit-P/10) with a child (PW-2) born on 29.03.2023 and she was below the age of 13 on the date of incident i.e. 22.02.2016 and the grounds raised were already considered on 27.06.2023 and rejected the application on merits and thereafter there is no sufficient period of custody warranting suspension.
Accordingly this repeat application is hereby dismissed at present.
Period of custody is only 3 years one month and twenty days only.
